column6: The offset only feeds (j + w) % 3, and adding 3 before that modulo leaves the result the same for every twist value, so the occupancy bytes are identical on clean and mutant code.

twists[7] only reaches build_occ, which reduces it modulo 3 before use, and the mutant values 6, 5, 4 carry the same residues as the clean values 0, 2, 1, so every generated scramble is byte for byte unchanged.

spins and budget only feed panic guards that already have should_panic tests, and once a guard goes quiet the walk loops forever instead of returning or failing, so the mutant can only show up as a hang and no terminating test can catch it.

the slot diagonal carries a nonzero component on every axis and the cross product of two slot face normals picks a single axis, so the dot product is always exactly 1 or minus 1, checked over all 48 slot face pairs, and the equals branch of >= is unreachable for every cube state.
SIGN holds only 1 and minus 1 for the six faces, so admitting zero changes no face and every layer permutation stays byte for byte the same.
the mutant raises the applied quarter turn count by exactly 4 and rot composes four quarter turns into the identity, so both counts land every sticker on the same cell for every quarter value.

both mutant sites freeze the scan index, the whitespace arm revisits the same separator char and the count digit walk rechecks the same digit forever, so any input reaching either branch loops without allocating or returning and the mutant can only surface as a timeout no terminating test can catch.

place_rigid never reads expected, its writes depend only on the from and to stickers, and it overwrites every slot of the 3 cycled pieces before the query loop, so the flipped home prefill changes no lookup, cycled stickers resolve to their destination and all others to home under both variants.

the ch masks (e and f) and (not e and g) are bitwise disjoint so or equals xor, and the maj chain is 1 per bit exactly when at least two of the three pair products are set, where xor equals or, so all three swaps leave every digest identical.

a one byte digit token returns false under both guards, the clean path fails the alphabetic check at index 0 and the mutant path walks past the end into the same index >= len rejection, and every other input enters the branch identically.

the group content can never hold a close bracket so the mutant guard stays false, the skipped rejection only delays the verdict because every expansion keeps an unmatched open bracket, and every such input terminates in the same BadRepeat carrying the original alg payload, verified by the hand applied mutant passing the full suite.

the inner substring of a matched pair in a push pop walk is balanced by construction so it holds ( exactly when it holds ), the two guards agree on every reachable input, corroborated by the strongest kill attempt passing identically under the hand applied mutant.

both mutant sites freeze the scan index on the whitespace skip and the digit run walk, so any input whose bytes reach that branch loop forever and can only surface as a hang no terminating test can catch, while every input that terminates skips the branch unchanged and normalizes byte for byte identically.

the sign test only names which of the two vertices of an axis a point is, every consumer feeds the id into symmetric face masks, and the label swap is a bijection the whole table construction commutes with, so the hand applied mutant leaves every oracle green.
the component at the found axis is always plus or minus 1 and never zero, so the equals case of the mutant is unreachable and both operators agree on every vertex the engine constructs.
a face folds over three distinct vertices so the accumulated bits are disjoint and or equals xor on every face.

flipping the cycle choice per quarter composes with the chirality probe at the quarter extraction and the two flips cancel, so every face construction yields the identical table, checked numerically over all 8 faces in playground/m1.

the sole call site extracts the rotation quarter, on all 8 face constructions every mutated division lands on a nonzero divisor and truncates to the clean product, verified numerically in playground/m1/fto_dot_cross_equivalence.py.

the closing addend is zero on all 8 face constructions because one factor is always zero, so joining it with a minus changes nothing, verified numerically in playground/m1/fto_dot_cross_equivalence.py.

cross feeds only the quarter extraction, over the 8 face constructions the anchor and rotated vectors carry zeros in the mutated slots so each of these 5 plus mutants evaluates a zero pair and reproduces the clean quarter vector, verified numerically in playground/m1/fto_dot_cross_equivalence.py.

the two slash mutants divide an always zero slot by a nonzero component or a sign by the same sign, both truncate to the clean product on all 8 constructions, verified numerically in playground/m1/fto_dot_cross_equivalence.py.

flipping the cycle choice per quarter composes with the chirality probe at the clockwise check and the two flips cancel, so every construction yields the identical table, same cancellation as the fto rotate row.

the only callers are the clockwise probe and the anchor side check inside the table build, every construction input holds zeros or matching sign values in the mutated slots so each mutant returns the clean value on every face, confirmed by the hand applied mutants running the full oracle suite green.

cross only sees the fixed probe and the rotated anchor images whose mutated slots are zero or matching signs on every construction input, so each of these 5 plus mutants returns the clean cross, confirmed by the hand applied mutants running the full oracle suite green.

the two slash mutants divide zero or equal magnitude signs so truncation returns the clean product on every construction input, confirmed by the hand applied mutants running the full oracle suite green.
